newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize plods up after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize plods up after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine maize shuffled slightly higher after a firmer CBOT in cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, traders said.

But Chicago's recent volatility has left market players wary and volume was thin. Prices paid to farmers for Buenos Aires maize rose $1 to $112. May soybeans also firmed in low volume in the wake of Chicago, rising $5 in Buenos Aires to $290. Cash sunflower seed firmed $3 to $218 in Buenos Aires, helped by pricier soybeans and lack of supply. Bahia Blanca wheat firmed $2 to $148, with late-season supply hard to come by.
